about.title: About HYT Engineering – Railway Machine Tools
about.description: Since 1977 HYT Engineering has designed, built and supported CNC wheel lathes and railway workshop machines from Pune, India. Our story, values and way of work.
about.lede: We design, build, install and support the machines that keep railway wheelsets in shape – one discipline, followed from Pune since 1977.
about.summary: Our story, our way of working and the values behind every HYT machine.

blocks.heading: From workshop lathes to railway wheel technology
paragraphs: HYT began in 1977 as HYT Engineering Corporation, building small drilling machines and lathes for local industry. In 1989 the business was incorporated as HYT Engineering Company Pvt. Ltd. and set itself a more demanding goal: machining the components on which railway safety depends.

That goal led us to the railway wheelset. A worn wheel profile affects ride quality, rail wear, energy use and derailment risk, and restoring it quickly decides how many trains are available each morning. HYT pioneered CNC wheel lathe technology in India and has kept wheel and axle machining at the centre of its work ever since.

Today we supply underfloor, surface and portal wheel lathes, wheel and axle shop machines, depot equipment and complete workshops to railways, metros and industry – and we stay with each machine for its whole working life. Read the milestones on our [History](page:history) page.

items.title: Precision
items.text: A tenth of a millimetre on a wheel profile matters. We design, build and test to that standard.

items.title: Safety first

items.title: Accountability

items.text: We judge a machine by its output over twenty years, not by its first week in service.

We also meet the international rail industry at exhibitions such as Asia Pacific Rail, Middle East Rail, Africa Rail and AusRAIL, where we share what we have learned about wheelset maintenance with operators from many networks.

history.title: Our History – HYT Engineering Since 1977
history.description: From drilling machines in 1977 to India's first indigenous wheel lathes, SAFOP in Italy and InnoTrans 2026 – the milestones that shaped HYT Engineering.
history.lede: Almost five decades of precision engineering in Pune – from the first machines for Indian Railways in 1977 to an international group with SAFOP S.p.A. in Italy.
history.summary: Milestones from our founding in 1977 to India's first indigenous wheel lathes, SAFOP and international markets.

blocks.heading: From drilling machines to a global engineering group
paragraphs: Established in 1977 under the leadership of Mr. Bhojraj Hemraj Teli, HYT Engineering Company began with a mission to manufacture quality precision machines. From beginning as a maker of drilling machines, HYT has grown into a trusted engineering group, providing advanced railway maintenance machinery, precision machine tools and turnkey solutions to customers in India and international markets.
blocks.image_alt: Sample illustration of machine tools being assembled in the HYT works

items.title: Establishment of HYT Engineering Corporation
items.text: Mr. Bhojraj Hemraj Teli established HYT Engineering Corporation in Pune with a single mission – to manufacture quality precision machines for Railways. Early work focused on machines for the rehabilitation of traction motors and the regeneration of armatures, laying the foundation for a specialised engineering enterprise.

items.title: Development and supply of the Mica Under Cutting Machine
items.text: HYT developed and supplied the Mica Under Cutting Machine – an early specialised product showing the company's growing capability in precision machine tool development for the railway sector.

items.title: Development and supply of the Universal Armature Machine
items.text: The Universal Armature Machine was developed and supplied, expanding HYT's portfolio of specialised machines for railway traction motor maintenance and rehabilitation.

items.title: HYT Engineering Company Pvt. Ltd.
items.text: The business was incorporated as HYT Engineering Company Pvt. Ltd., giving it the structure to take on larger engineering contracts.

items.title: India's first indigenous Surface Wheel Lathe
items.text: A landmark year. HYT developed and supplied India's first indigenous Surface Wheel Lathe, marking the company's entry into wheel lathe technology.

items.title: India's first indigenous Underfloor Wheel Lathe and Axle Journal Turning Lathe
items.text: HYT achieved another national first, developing and supplying India's first indigenous Underfloor (Pit) Wheel Lathe and the Axle Journal Turning and Burnishing Lathe.

blocks.heading: The CNC era and global reach

items.title: Establishment of HYT Innovative Projects Pvt. Ltd.
items.text: HYT expanded the group by establishing HYT Innovative Projects Pvt. Ltd. as a sister concern, specialising in precision tube manufacture using Flow Forming technology, from a 4,500 m² facility with a team of 50+ employees.

items.title: From non-CNC to CNC machines
items.text: HYT completed a transformative upgrade from non-CNC to CNC, developing and supplying the CNC Surface Wheel Lathe and the CNC Vertical Turning Lathe – positioning itself as a technology-led engineering company aligned with global manufacturing standards.

items.title: Export order – SMH Rail Sdn. Bhd., Malaysia
items.text: A defining milestone. HYT received an international order from SMH Rail Sdn. Bhd., Malaysia, beginning the company's global footprint and its transformation into an internationally recognised machine tool exporter.

items.title: Reconditioning of a submarine manufacturing machine – Mazagon Dock Ltd.
items.text: HYT demonstrated its versatility by successfully reconditioning a submarine manufacturing machine for Mazagon Dock Ltd., extending its expertise beyond railways into defence and heavy engineering.

items.title: Larsen & Toubro order
items.text: HYT received a landmark order from Larsen & Toubro for the supply of machines for wheel disc manufacturing – one of its largest single orders, cementing HYT's position.

items.title: Automated Train Wash Plant – Kurla, Mumbai
items.text: HYT developed and supplied India's first Automated Train Wash Plant for Indian Railways at Kurla, Mumbai – introducing a new product category and demonstrating the ability to innovate beyond wheel lathes into broader rail infrastructure.

items.title: CNC Vertical Turning and Boring Machine
items.text: HYT developed and supplied the CNC Vertical Turning and Boring Machine – a high-precision machine for large-diameter components that significantly expanded the company's addressable market and technical capability.

items.title: LHB coach shell manufacturing facility – ICF Chennai
items.text: HYT entered the turnkey EPC domain with its first major infrastructure project, setting up an LHB coach shell manufacturing facility for Integral Coach Factory, Chennai. This marked the transformation from machine tool supplier to complete infrastructure solutions provider.

items.title: Largest-ever single order for CNC Surface Wheel Lathes – 36 machines
items.text: HYT received its largest single order for CNC Surface Wheel Lathes, for 36 machines, demonstrating the scale of demand for the company's flagship products across Indian Railways.

items.title: Ms. Rajashri Teli appointed Whole Time Director
items.text: Ms. Rajashri Bhojraj Teli was appointed Whole Time Director, bringing progressive business strategies that would drive significant expansion and global recognition for the group.

items.title: CNC Portal Wheel Lathe – North Central Railway, Jhansi
items.text: HYT supplied the CNC Portal Wheel Lathe to North Central Railway's wagon repair workshop at Jhansi, adding another variant to its wheel lathe portfolio and strengthening its relationship with Indian Railways.

items.title: CNC Underfloor Wheel Lathes – Chennai Metro
items.text: HYT expanded into the metro segment by supplying CNC Underfloor Wheel Lathes to Chennai Metro – the first of many metro contracts that established HYT as a preferred supplier for India's growing urban rail network.

items.title: Rail cum Road Vehicle (Shunter) developed with BEMO, Netherlands
items.text: HYT developed the Rail cum Road Vehicle (Shunter) under a Make in India initiative in collaboration with BEMO, Netherlands – a versatile vehicle for railway yard operations.

items.title: Green Building headquarters established in Pune
items.text: HYT established its Green Building headquarters in Chinchwad, Pune – a modern, sustainable facility that became the central hub for engineering, manufacturing and administration.

items.title: CNC spring coiling machines – technology transfer from TNI Spring Technologies, USA
items.text: HYT manufactured and supplied the CNC Hot Helical Spring Coiling Machine, CNC Hot Bar End Tapering Machine and Re-pitching Machine for the spring project at ICF Chennai, under a technology transfer from TNI Spring Technologies LLC, USA – demonstrating HYT's ability to assimilate and deploy international technology.

items.title: Supply to Alstom and GE Diesel Locomotive Pvt. Ltd.
items.text: HYT supplied new-generation Underfloor Wheel Lathe machines to Alstom and GE Diesel Locomotive Pvt. Ltd., marking entry into the international OEM supply chain for rolling stock manufacturers.

items.title: Wet leasing (Machine as a Service) – ICF Chennai
items.text: HYT pioneered a wet leasing contract for ICF Chennai, taking full responsibility for supply, commissioning, operation and maintenance – a first-of-its-kind service model in the Indian rail machinery sector. See [wet leasing](page:wet-leasing).

items.title: Acquisition of SAFOP S.p.A., Italy – 100% subsidiary
items.text: HYT's most significant strategic move – the acquisition of SAFOP S.p.A., Italy (established 1923) as a subsidiary. With over 1,400 machines sold globally and a century of Italian precision engineering, SAFOP dramatically expanded the group's global presence and technology portfolio.

items.title: India's first indigenous automated wheel and axle assembly plant – RWF Bangalore
items.text: HYT developed and set up India's first indigenous Automated Wheel and Axle Assembly Plant for Rail Wheel Factory, Bangalore – a landmark in railway wheelset manufacturing automation.

items.title: Supply to SNCF France – compliant with European norms
items.text: HYT developed and supplied Underfloor Wheel Lathes to SNCF France in compliance with European standards – a landmark export achievement that validated HYT's quality on the world stage.

items.title: Order for 27 Underfloor Wheel Lathes – Indian Railways
items.text: HYT received an order for 27 Underfloor Wheel Lathes from Indian Railways – one of the largest single wheel lathe orders, reinforcing its position as the preferred supplier for Indian Railways' rolling stock maintenance infrastructure.

items.title: CNC Underfloor Wheel Lathe supplied to Gabon, and CNC Surface Wheel Lathe to Ghana
items.text: HYT supplied and commissioned a CNC Underfloor Wheel Lathe in Gabon, Central Africa, setting up a complete wheel shop in the region, and delivered a CNC Surface Wheel Lathe to Ghana, West Africa – demonstrating strong demand across the African rail market.

items.title: Automated wheel shop at New Katni and axle machining line at RWF Bangalore
items.text: HYT executed an automated wheel shop EPC project at New Katni, Madhya Pradesh – one of Indian Railways' largest wheel maintenance facilities – and set up a complete axle machining line at Rail Wheel Factory, Bangalore.

items.title: India's first indigenous Tandem Underfloor Wheel Lathe
items.text: HYT developed India's first indigenous Tandem Underfloor Wheel Lathe – a twin-machine configuration for ultra-high-throughput wheel shops, awarded by Delhi Metro Rail Corporation.

items.title: First Vande Bharat maintenance depot – Shakur Basti, Northern Railway
items.text: HYT set up India's first dedicated maintenance depot for the Vande Bharat Express at Shakur Basti under Northern Railway – a landmark achievement as the country's flagship semi-high-speed train entered service, with HYT machines integral to its upkeep.

items.title: Bogie Assembly and Disassembly Line – Dibrugarh
items.text: HYT delivered a Bogie Assembly and Disassembly Line at Dibrugarh for Northeast Frontier Railway – a sophisticated semi-automated assembly solution bringing modern manufacturing practice to one of India's most geographically challenging rail regions.

items.title: Large horizontal machines for turbine rotor maintenance
items.text: HYT and SAFOP secured orders for large horizontal machines for the maintenance of turbine rotors.

items.title: Five international exhibitions across four continents
items.text: HYT exhibited at Middle East Rail in Dubai, Eurasia Rail in Istanbul, Asia Pacific Rail in Bangkok, Africa Rail in Johannesburg and NT Expo in São Paulo – the company's widest international showing in a single year.

items.title: Orders from the Middle East and Turkey
items.text: HYT secured orders from the Middle East and Turkey for underfloor wheel lathes, tandem underfloor wheel lathes, axle turning lathes and vertical turning lathes.

items.title: Managing Director recognised at Hurun Stars of the Deccan
items.text: Ms. Rajashri Teli, Managing Director, was recognised at Hurun Stars of the Deccan 2026 – acknowledging her role in the group's growth and international expansion.

items.title: HYT Group exhibits at InnoTrans 2026, Berlin
items.text: HYT Engineering and SAFOP S.p.A. exhibited together as the HYT Group at InnoTrans 2026 – Hall 22A, Stands 630 & 730, Messe Berlin, 22–25 September 2026 – presenting the full CNC wheel lathe range to the world's leading transport technology audience.

quality.title: Quality Assurance – From Design to Acceptance
quality.description: How HYT builds quality into every wheel lathe: design reviews, incoming and in-process inspection, run-off tests on customer wheelsets and full documentation.
quality.lede: A wheel lathe sets the profile that a train runs on. We treat quality as a process that starts with the first drawing and ends only when the machine has proved itself on your wheelsets.
quality.summary: Our quality process from design review to acceptance testing on the customer's own wheelsets.

blocks.heading: Quality you can measure on the wheel
paragraphs: An error in a machine tool is copied into every part it makes. On a wheel lathe that means every wheel profile, on every train, for years. Accuracy, repeatability and reliability are therefore not extras – they are the product.

Our quality management system is certified to ISO 9001:2015. The certificate confirms that the process exists and is audited; the steps below show how it works in practice. Certificates for quality, environment and occupational health and safety are collected on the [Certifications](page:certifications) page.
blocks.image_alt: Sample illustration of an inspector measuring a machined component in the HYT quality area

blocks.heading: Certified to international standards
blocks.intro: Our quality, environmental and occupational health & safety management systems are independently certified by Intercert.

blocks.heading: Six checkpoints between order and handover

items.title: Contract & design review
items.text: Customer specifications, wheel profiles, gauge and site conditions are reviewed by engineering before design begins, and each design is checked against them before release.

items.title: Supplier control & incoming inspection
items.text: Castings, structures, bought-out components and CNC systems are sourced from evaluated suppliers and inspected on arrival against drawings and specifications.

items.title: In-process inspection
items.text: Critical machined features, geometry and alignments are checked at defined stages of manufacture and assembly, with results recorded.

items.title: Factory testing
items.text: Each machine is run, its functions and safety interlocks are tested and its geometric accuracy is verified in our works before dispatch.

items.title: Site run-off & acceptance
items.text: After installation, the machine is proved on the customer's own wheelsets. Profiles and dimensions are measured and the results are signed off with the customer.

items.title: Documentation & handover
items.text: Inspection records, test reports, manuals, drawings and spare-parts lists are handed over with the machine, supporting audits and future maintenance.

items.title: Feedback from the field
items.text: Service reports and customer feedback are reviewed and fed back into design and manufacturing.

items.title: Root-cause analysis
items.text: Non-conformities are investigated to their cause and corrected so they do not recur.

items.title: Skilled people
items.text: Inspectors, assemblers and service engineers are trained in the methods and standards that apply to their work.

certifications.title: ISO 9001, ISO 14001 & ISO 45001 Certifications
certifications.description: HYT Engineering's management systems are certified to ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018. What each standard covers and why it matters to you.
certifications.lede: Our quality, environmental and occupational health and safety management systems are independently certified. Here is what each certificate means for customers and partners.
certifications.summary: ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 – what each certificate covers.

blocks.heading: Our ISO certificates
blocks.intro: HYT Engineering Company Pvt. Ltd. is certified by Intercert to three international management-system standards. Select a certificate to view it in full.

blocks.heading: Three standards, one way of working
blocks.intro: Each standard is audited by an independent certification body. Together they cover how we build machines, how we treat the environment and how we protect people.

items.title: ISO 9001:2015 – Quality management
items.text: Requires a documented, audited process for understanding customer requirements, controlling design, purchasing and production, and correcting problems. For you, it means consistent machines and traceable records.

items.title: ISO 14001:2015 – Environmental management
items.text: Requires us to identify the environmental impact of our operations – energy, waste, emissions, coolants and oils – and to control and reduce it. For you, it means a supplier that manages its footprint.

items.title: ISO 45001:2018 – Occupational health & safety
items.text: Requires us to identify hazards and prevent injury and ill health in our works and on customer sites. For you, it means safer installation and service work in your depot.

blocks.heading: Using our certificates in your supplier approval
paragraphs: Railway and metro tenders often require proof of certified management systems. Our current certificates – with certified scope, certification body and validity dates – are shown above; select one to view it in full, or verify it with Intercert using the registration number.

If you need certificates for a tender or a supplier audit sooner, [contact us](page:contact-us) and we will send them directly. To see how ISO 9001 works in practice on the shop floor, read about our [quality process](page:quality), and for our commitments in each area see the [Policy Statement](page:policy-statement).

blocks.heading: Operators who cannot afford idle trains
paragraphs: Our customers run high-utilisation fleets on tight maintenance schedules. For them, a wheel lathe is not an occasional tool but a daily bottleneck: every hour a train waits for re-profiling is an hour it is not earning revenue or carrying passengers.

That is why they look for more than a machine. They need foundations designed correctly the first time, operators trained on their own vehicles and a service partner who responds when it matters. sections.heading: 1. Purpose and scope
paragraphs: HYT Engineering Company Pvt. Ltd. ("HYT") designs, builds and services machines on which railway safety depends. Our customers, many of them public authorities, trust us to act honestly and responsibly. This Code explains what that means in practice.

The Code applies to all directors, managers and employees of HYT, including temporary and contract staff. We also expect agents, consultants, suppliers, subcontractors and other business partners acting on our behalf to follow equivalent standards.
The Code does not cover every situation. Where it is silent, use good judgement, follow the law and ask for advice when in doubt.

sections.heading: 2. Acting with integrity
paragraphs: We comply with all laws and regulations that apply to our business in India and in every country where we work. Where local custom and the law differ, we follow the law. Where this Code sets a higher standard than the law, we follow this Code.
bullets: Be honest and accurate in everything we say about our products, services and capabilities.
Keep promises made to customers, or explain early and openly when we cannot.
Never falsify records, test results, inspection reports or certificates.

sections.heading: 3. Anti-bribery and anti-corruption
paragraphs: HYT does not tolerate bribery or corruption in any form. We do not offer, promise, give, request or accept any payment, gift or advantage intended to improperly influence a business decision – whether the other party is a public official or a private individual.
This applies equally to payments made through agents, consultants, distributors or relatives. Facilitation payments to speed up routine government actions are not permitted.
bullets: Gifts and hospitality may be given or accepted only if they are modest, infrequent, transparent and not linked to a pending decision, and only in line with our [Business Conduct Guidelines](page:guidelines).
We respect the procurement rules of our customers, including integrity pacts and codes of conduct in public tenders.
Agents and intermediaries are appointed only after due diligence, under written contracts and for documented services at fair market fees.
All payments are properly authorised and accurately recorded.

sections.heading: 4. Conflicts of interest
paragraphs: A conflict of interest arises when personal interests – financial, family or otherwise – could influence, or appear to influence, decisions made on behalf of HYT.

Employees must avoid such conflicts where possible and disclose any actual or potential conflict to their manager in writing. Examples include a financial interest in a supplier, customer or competitor; outside employment that competes with HYT; or involvement in a purchasing decision affecting a relative.

sections.heading: 5. Fair competition
paragraphs: We win business on the merits of our machines, our service and our prices. We comply with competition law in every market we serve.
bullets: We do not agree prices, bids, markets or customers with competitors, and we do not take part in bid rigging.
We do not exchange commercially sensitive information with competitors.
We obtain information about competitors and tenders only by lawful and ethical means.
We describe competitors' products fairly and accurately.

sections.heading: 6. Health and safety
paragraphs: Nobody should be harmed by working for HYT or by using our machines. Our occupational health and safety management system is certified to ISO 45001:2018.
bullets: Follow safety rules, permits and instructions in our works and on customer sites.
Use the personal protective equipment required for the task.
Stop work that is unsafe and report hazards, incidents and near misses immediately.
Never work under the influence of alcohol or drugs.
Design machines with the safety of operators and maintenance staff as a primary requirement.

sections.heading: 7. Environment
paragraphs: We work to reduce the environmental impact of our operations and products. Our environmental management system is certified to ISO 14001:2015.
bullets: Comply with environmental laws and permits.
Use energy, materials and water efficiently.
Handle, store and dispose of oils, coolants, chemicals and waste correctly.
Consider energy use, noise and recyclability when designing machines.

sections.heading: 8. Confidential information and intellectual property
paragraphs: Our designs, drawings, software, pricing and know-how are valuable assets. Customers and suppliers also entrust us with their confidential information, including drawings, infrastructure data and project documents.
bullets: Use confidential information only for the purpose for which it was provided.
Share it only with people who need it for their work and are authorised to receive it.
Respect the intellectual property of others, including software licences.
Confidentiality obligations continue after employment with HYT ends.

sections.heading: 9. Data protection and information security
paragraphs: We collect and use personal data – of employees, customers, applicants and suppliers – only for legitimate business purposes, keep it secure and retain it no longer than necessary, in line with applicable data protection law and our [Privacy Policy](page:privacy-policy).
Everyone must protect company systems and data: use strong passwords, do not share accounts, report suspected security incidents promptly and take care with remote access to machine control systems.

sections.heading: 10. Human rights and fair labour
paragraphs: We respect the human rights of our employees and of everyone affected by our business.
bullets: We do not use child labour, forced labour or bonded labour, and we do not accept them in our supply chain.
We treat people with dignity and do not tolerate harassment, bullying or discrimination on any ground, including gender, caste, religion, ethnicity, age, disability or sexual orientation.
We pay at least the legally required wages and benefits and respect working-time rules.
We respect employees' lawful right to join or not to join associations.

sections.heading: 11. Company assets and accurate records
paragraphs: Company equipment, materials, vehicles and funds are to be used for legitimate business purposes and protected from loss, theft and misuse. Books, records and reports must be complete, accurate and prepared in line with applicable accounting standards and law.

sections.heading: 12. Raising concerns
paragraphs: Anyone who suspects a breach of this Code, the law or company policy is encouraged to speak up as early as possible. Concerns can be raised with a line manager, the HR department or a member of senior management. Business partners and members of the public may write to HYT Engineering Company Pvt. Ltd., 29/10, 29/10/1, 29/10/2, D-II Block, MIDC Chinchwad, Pune 411019, India, or email info@hytengineering.com, marking the message "Confidential – Code of Conduct".
Every concern will be taken seriously, handled confidentially as far as the law allows and investigated fairly.

sections.heading: 13. No retaliation
paragraphs: HYT will not tolerate retaliation against anyone who raises a concern in good faith or cooperates with an investigation, even if the concern turns out to be unfounded. Retaliation is itself a serious breach of this Code.

sections.heading: 14. Compliance with this Code
paragraphs: Managers are responsible for making sure their teams understand and follow this Code. Breaches may lead to disciplinary action up to and including dismissal and, for business partners, termination of the relationship. Where the law has been broken, HYT may inform the relevant authorities.

This Code is reviewed periodically and updated when needed. Practical guidance on applying it is provided in our [Business Conduct Guidelines](page:guidelines), and our commitments on quality, environment, health and safety are set out in the [Policy Statement](page:policy-statement).

guidelines.title: Business Conduct Guidelines
guidelines.description: Practical guidance for HYT employees and partners on gifts, hospitality, public tenders, agents, export controls, site conduct, records and communication.
guidelines.lede: These guidelines turn the principles of our Code of Conduct into practical rules for everyday situations in sales, purchasing, projects and service.
guidelines.summary: Practical rules on gifts, tenders, agents, export controls, site conduct and records.

blocks.text: For HYT review: the menu label "Guidelines" is vague; this page is titled "Business Conduct Guidelines". Please confirm the label and the intended content, and approve the text (including any monetary limits for gifts and hospitality) with management and legal counsel.

sections.heading: 1. How to use these guidelines
paragraphs: These guidelines support the [Code of Conduct](page:code-of-conduct) and apply to the same people: everyone working for HYT, and partners acting on our behalf. If a situation is not covered, ask yourself: Is it legal? Is it consistent with the Code? Would I be comfortable if it were reported to our customer or published? If the answer to any question is no, or you are unsure, ask your manager before acting.

sections.heading: 2. Gifts and hospitality
paragraphs: Modest gifts and hospitality can support good business relationships, but they must never create an obligation or the appearance of one.
bullets: Accept or offer only items of modest value, such as promotional items, normal business meals or festival sweets, within limits set by management.
Never give or accept cash, cash equivalents, vouchers, loans or personal favours.
Do not offer gifts or hospitality to customer staff involved in a current tender, inspection or acceptance decision.
Respect the rules of the recipient's organisation – many public bodies prohibit gifts entirely.
Record gifts and hospitality above the agreed threshold and inform your manager.

sections.heading: 3. Working with public customers and tenders
paragraphs: Many of our customers are public railway and metro authorities. Their procurement rules exist to ensure fairness and value for public money, and we respect them fully.
bullets: Submit truthful, complete tender documents and technical data.
Comply with integrity pacts, pre-bid procedures and communication rules set by the customer.
Do not seek or use confidential information about a tender or a competitor's bid.
Do not discuss employment opportunities with public officials involved in decisions affecting HYT.
Report any request for an improper payment immediately and refuse it.

sections.heading: 4. Agents, consultants and partners
bullets: Appoint intermediaries only for genuine, documented services and after background checks.
Use written contracts that include anti-bribery and compliance clauses.
Pay fees that are proportionate to the work, into accounts in the name of the contracting party and in the country where services are performed.
Watch for warning signs such as requests for unusual payments, cash, or secrecy.

sections.heading: 5. Purchasing and suppliers
bullets: Select suppliers on quality, delivery, price, safety and ethical performance.
Treat all suppliers fairly and keep their quotations confidential.
Declare any personal relationship with a supplier and step back from the decision.
Expect suppliers to meet the standards of our Code of Conduct; new suppliers can register through [Supplier Registration](page:supplier-registration).

sections.heading: 6. Exports, sanctions and customs
paragraphs: Machines, spare parts, software and technical data may be subject to export control, sanctions and customs rules in India and in other countries. Check end-use, end-user and destination before quoting or shipping to a new customer or country, declare goods accurately to customs, and seek advice if anything is unclear.

sections.heading: 7. Conduct on customer sites
bullets: Follow the customer's safety rules, permit-to-work systems and track-access procedures without exception.
Wear the required personal protective equipment and use only approved tools and lifting equipment.
Treat customer premises, equipment and information with care.
Report incidents, near misses and damage immediately to the customer and to HYT.

sections.heading: 8. Records, documents and reports
bullets: Record every transaction accurately and on time.
Never alter inspection results, test reports, timesheets or expense claims.
Keep documents for the periods required by law and by contract.
Do not destroy documents that may be relevant to an audit, investigation or legal proceeding.

sections.heading: 9. Communication and social media
bullets: Only authorised people may speak to the media or publish statements on behalf of HYT.
Do not post confidential information, customer details, site photographs or drawings on social media without approval.
Make clear that personal opinions are your own.

sections.heading: 10. IT and information security
bullets: Use company IT systems for business purposes and in line with company rules.
Protect passwords and do not share accounts.
Be alert to phishing and report suspicious messages.
Connect to customer machines and networks only with authorisation and approved tools.

sections.heading: 11. Asking for advice and reporting concerns
paragraphs: If you are unsure what to do, ask your manager, the HR department or senior management. Concerns about possible breaches can be raised through the channels described in section 12 of the [Code of Conduct](page:code-of-conduct). Nobody will suffer for raising a concern in good faith.

policy-statement.title: Quality, Environment, Health & Safety Policy
policy-statement.description: HYT's integrated policy on quality, environment and occupational health and safety in line with ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001, plus our anti-bribery commitment.
policy-statement.lede: Our commitments on quality, environment, occupational health and safety and business integrity, consistent with our ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems.
policy-statement.summary: Our integrated commitments on quality, environment, health and safety and anti-bribery.

sections.heading: Our purpose
paragraphs: HYT Engineering Company Pvt. Ltd. designs, manufactures, installs and services CNC wheel lathes, wheel and axle shop machines, depot equipment and turnkey workshops for railways, metros and industry. The machines we build help keep rolling stock safe. That responsibility shapes the way we manage quality, the environment, and the health and safety of everyone involved in our work.

sections.heading: Quality
paragraphs: We commit to delivering machines and services that meet customer requirements and applicable standards, on time and with full documentation. To achieve this we will:
bullets: understand and review customer requirements before we commit to them;
control design, purchasing, manufacturing, installation and service through documented processes;
verify our machines through inspection and testing, including acceptance on customer wheelsets;
measure customer satisfaction and learn from feedback and non-conformities;
continually improve the effectiveness of our quality management system to ISO 9001:2015.

sections.heading: Environment
paragraphs: We commit to protecting the environment and preventing pollution across our operations and products. We will:
bullets: comply with applicable environmental laws, permits and other requirements;
use energy, water and materials efficiently;
minimise waste, and handle oils, coolants and hazardous materials safely;
consider environmental performance when designing machines and selecting suppliers;
continually improve our environmental management system to ISO 14001:2015.

sections.heading: Occupational health and safety
paragraphs: We commit to providing safe and healthy working conditions to prevent work-related injury and ill health – in our works and on customer sites. We will:
bullets: comply with applicable health and safety laws and customer site rules;
identify hazards, assess risks and eliminate or reduce them using the hierarchy of controls;
provide training, information and suitable protective equipment;
consult and involve employees and their representatives in safety matters;
design our machines with the safety of operators and maintenance staff in mind;
continually improve our occupational health and safety management system to ISO 45001:2018.

sections.heading: Business integrity and anti-bribery
paragraphs: We commit to conducting business honestly and fairly. HYT prohibits bribery and corruption in all forms, whether involving public officials or private parties, directly or through intermediaries. We comply with applicable anti-corruption and competition laws and respect the procurement rules of our customers. These commitments are explained in our [Code of Conduct](page:code-of-conduct) and [Business Conduct Guidelines](page:guidelines).

sections.heading: Putting this policy into practice
paragraphs: Management sets measurable objectives under this policy, provides the resources needed to achieve them and reviews performance regularly. Every employee is responsible for working in line with this policy, and we expect the same of our suppliers and subcontractors.

This policy is communicated to all employees, made available to interested parties on this website and reviewed periodically to make sure it remains suitable. Details of our certificates are on the [Certifications](page:certifications) page.
